title: Contract bundle keeps only ticks' own formats (7.0.0)
description: Remove every fixture that describes a ticfac/factory format (job-protocol, ticfac-run-state, lifecycle-invariants, collect-vocabulary, run-event-feed, runners-config-contract, worker-boot-contract, message-context, sweep-selection-contract, sweep-policy-cases, signal-source-cases, sandbox-image-cases, credential-ownership) with its ticks-side readers; keep tk-json-manifest and tracker-layout. MAJOR bump; README and CHANGELOG say ticfac authors the removed formats from ticfac 6in onward, and ticfac's pin at 6.3.0 keeps working until it adopts 7.0.0.
acceptance_criteria: [A4] of the epic; make contracts-bundle-check ok at 7.0.0; the remaining readers (tkcontract, tick parity) pass.
closed_reason: Bundle 7.0.0: tk-json-manifest + tracker-layout only; 13 fixtures removed with their readers; CHANGELOG names ticfac 4i8 as their author from here
